body_lead: CHENNAI: Chief minister M K Stalin has invited technology majors Apple, Google and Microsoft to invest and expand their operations in the state. Stalin, who is currently touring the US to attract investments, also met LinkedIn chief executive Ryan Roslanski among others, according to a release from the govt. Guidance TN, the state govt's nodal agency for investment promotion, will set up an artificial intelligence (AI) lab in partnership with Google for which a memorandum of understanding (MoU) was signed with the company on Friday.
